title: GOD SHALL BRUISE SATAN
VICTORY IN MIDNIGHT PRAYER
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: If the conflict in your mind reached breaking point tonight, listen closely right now.
And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Lord, we stand in the stillness of midnight, weary from battles fought in silence.
The spiritual enemy has tried to steal your quiet assurance and leave only fear in this room.
But your divine promise is sure: your peace is a force that crushes all darkness beneath our feet.
We surrender every lingering tension, stepping boldly into your complete victory tonight.
May your unmerited grace fill every corner of this quiet space.
